{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for converters (converted == 1) and valid age (customer_age != -1)
converters = data[(data['converted'] == 1) & (data['customer_age'] != -1)]

# Compute the number of such customers and their mean age
n_converters_valid_age = len(converters)
mean_age = converters['customer_age'].mean()

# Print both numbers to ensure they are traceable
print(f"Number of converters with valid age (customer_age != -1): {n_converters_valid_age}")
print(f"Mean age of converters with valid age: {mean_age}")

# Round mean age to two decimal places for final answer
mean_age_rounded = round(mean_age, 2)

# Return the value for submission
mean_age_rounded"}
